changelog: Enhanced the Discover feature with advanced sorting and year filtering options.
Fixed media type detection issues for History cards.

features.title: What's New
items: Added year filtering to the Discover page for more precise content searches.
Added advanced sorting options (Top Rated, Newest, Popularity) to Discover.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Redesigned the Discover controls UI to perfectly fit the new filtering options.
Optimized the media grid layout for a seamless responsive experience without empty gaps.

features.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed a critical bug where TV shows in the History section were incorrectly detected as movies.
Fixed routing and navigation issues related to the History drag-and-drop cards.
